summary: Tested the manual 'Pay by bank transfer' feature end-to-end on the preview URL only. Backend: 6 pytest tests (5 pass, 1 fails). The one failure is a real bug in the admin UI mark-paid path. Frontend checkout works: the Wallid button, the 'or' divider and bank-transfer-btn all show; the button stays disabled until the compliance box is ticked. After clicking it, bank-transfer-details shows GHP Health LTD / 12-34-56 / 12345678, the reference GHP-061 and the amount £44.99, each with a copy button. The cart empties and the invoice PDF (invoice-GHP-061.pdf) downloads. The admin 'Awaiting transfer' badge, the printable invoice bank block, 'Payment method: Bank transfer', the Settings save, and hiding the option when the account number is blank all work. Marking paid via the PATCH API sets paid/manual/processing. Stock drops once and a repeat PATCH does not drop it again. The paid PDF and printable invoice have no bank block. BUG: marking paid from the admin order detail UI leaves fulfilment status 'pending' instead of 'processing'. The Wallid button was never clicked.

critical.issue: The admin UI always sends {status, payment_status, notes}. When the admin changes payment_status to 'paid', mark_order_paid sets status=processing, but the endpoint then writes the 'status':'pending' sent by the form over it. Result after a UI mark-paid: payment_status=paid, payment_source=manual, status=pending (reproduced on GHP-061). Older orders GHP-052 and GHP-043 show the same PAID/PENDING mismatch. Stock decrement and the email still run.

minor.issue: Anonymous orders can be switched to bank_transfer by anyone who has the order UUID. Low risk because UUIDs are hard to guess; noted only.

integration_issues.issue: The Fulfilment status select still holds the old value 'pending' and is sent with the PATCH, so the order never moves to processing.

issues: The invoice-bank-details block has no Amount field. The customer PDF and the checkout panel both include the amount.
The disabled card note says 'please use Pay by Bank above' and does not mention the bank-transfer option (cosmetic).

action_items: Fix the mark-paid status override in update_order_status (order_routes.py). When payment_status transitions to paid via mark_order_paid, drop updates['status'] if it is 'pending' or equals the existing status. Alternatively, have AdminOrderDetail send only the fields that changed. Then re-run tests/test_bank_transfer.py::TestBankTransferFlow::test_mark_paid_with_status_in_same_patch.
Optional: add Amount to the invoice-bank-details block in AdminOrderInvoice.jsx
Add data-testids: checkout form inputs and the 'Continue to payment' button, the AdminOrderDetail payment/fulfilment selects and Save button, and the AdminSettings 'Save settings' button
critical_code_review_comments: order_routes.update_order_status: after mark_order_paid, a 'status' value in the same payload overwrites 'processing'. This is the root cause of the bug above.
PUT /api/settings replaces the whole Settings object. Clients must send the full form; the UI does this correctly.
BankTransferPanel.download has no catch/toast on failure; the error is swallowed after `finally`.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all requested flows work; the only failure is the admin UI mark-paid status)

test_credentials: admin@ghp-health.com / GHP-Health26 (from /app/memory/test_credentials.md). Site is published, so no preview gate; the age gate was confirmed.
seed_data_creation: Created GHP-061 (banktest+20@example.com) through the UI and marked it paid through the admin UI; kept as a reproduction of the status bug. Deleted GHP-062 and GHP-063. Pytest orders are deleted in teardown. ahkcu-100mg stock was restored to 5. Bank settings were restored to GHP Health LTD / 12-34-56 / 12345678.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest /app/backend/tests/test_bank_transfer.py; it uses pymongo to restore product stock and decodes the ReportLab PDF streams (ASCII85+Flate) to check the text. Checkout inputs have no testids: fill #email, then the 7 inputs in form#details-form in order, then click button[form=details-form]. The settings save button is get_by_role('button', name='Save settings'); the page has a second form (change password). Never click wallid-pay-btn.
rca of the issue: Repro: create a bank-transfer order, open /admin/orders/{id}, set Payment status=paid, click Save changes. The frontend sends {status:'pending', payment_status:'paid'}. The backend runs mark_order_paid (status->processing), pops only payment_status, then runs $set with status='pending'. Fix: in the backend, ignore an unchanged or 'pending' status during the paid transition.
